meaning:
μεγαλύνω
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גָּדַל pi., hi. ;]
1. to make great: Mat.23:5, Luk.1:58.
2. to declare great, extol, magnify: Luk.1:46, Act.5:13 10:46 19:17, 2Co.10:15; pass., before ἐν, Php.1:20.†
(AS)
